EBC / Bike 305 Beginner Ride

Coral Gables, FL · Road

Beginner friendly

EBC / Bike 305 Beginner Ride is a road group ride in Coral Gables, FL. It rolls second Saturday of the month at 7:30 am from Ponce de Leon Middle School. About 10 miles, d, 12–14 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the EBC / Bike 305 Beginner Ride group ride

A ten-mile intro ride for people who have never ridden in a group. Slow pace, short distance, same start as the main club ride. Run once a month with the county's Bike 305 program.
